# Erdos.p236 — Erdős problem 236

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/236
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/236.lean`, theorem `erdos_236`, AMS 5 11).

Let $f(n)$ count the number of solutions to $n=p+2^k$ for prime $p$ and $k\geq 0$. Show that $f(n)=o(\log n)$.

## Statement
(fun n => (f n : ℝ)) =o[atTop] (fun n => Real.log (n : ℝ))

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
